scientificBasis.factorGap: Exact live current-main exposes a deterministic all-Art choice after one completed run. Exact research fixes Duskblade to authored-default Flare and has no plan or policy Art selector while automatically using the fixed Art.

scientificBasis.identityQuestion: The explicit Flare setting must be a semantic and trajectory null. Direct Beacon execution is confined to controlled combat states and must change only the authored Ember cost, self Beacon status and its existing Dusk-only unblocked-Attack Facet mediator.
scientificBasis.notCausal: No enabled Beacon whole-run, causal endpoint, package claim, candidate, product mutation, model, ML, RL, optimiser, Scoreline factor or Afterimage factor is present.

lanternArt.researchKnob: One optional StringName passed after current simulator construction. It accepts only omitted, flare or beacon and writes run.art after new_run without reading or advancing RNG.

executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop when all direct maps and every complete whole-run null identity are exact with zero reliability, ledger or protected-seed fault.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop and close the Lantern-Art research factor on any direct map, null path, RNG, policy, result, reliability, schema or probe failure. Do not repair or rerun.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at decision boundary 3 on timeout, wall-time cap or ledger drift without changing the protocol, cohort or rows.

decisionRules.success: Every direct and whole-run gate passes exactly within all numeric ceilings.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze the default-Flare versus explicit-Beacon Lantern-Art factor as identity-safe and preregister its next evidence-backed capacity block before any enabled Beacon whole-run.
